get.description:
Level 5 AI Model: Sandboxed AI Policy Controller & Optimization Suite.
Uses Surrogate-Guided Model Predictive Control (MPC) to evaluate candidate
policy configurations and recommend optimal adjustments to maximize societal welfare.

Returns current status of the Human Evolutionary Behavioral Model,
including online adaptation epochs, learned instances, and domain weights.

Returns verified empirical accuracy benchmarks, goodness-of-fit R2,
mean absolute error (MAE), directional concordance, and 5-fold cross-validation proofs.

Serves the publication-quality 4-page academic PDF report covering EDA,
feature distributions, correlation matrices, and 5-fold cross-validation accuracy proof.

post.description:
Triggers a live cross-validation re-training cycle against empirical benchmark datasets
to verify and refine model prediction accuracy.

Submits a policy (standard catalog or custom user edict) to the Deliberative Council
and the Human Evolutionary Behavioral Model. Evaluates cohort approval, happiness/stability
deltas, protest risk, and generates advisor debate arguments.

Allows the sovereign user to draft and register their own custom edict
with unique parameters, budget impact, and domain targets.

Online Incremental Self-Learning Endpoint:
Logs an enacted policy instance and trains the Evolutionary Behavioral Model
to adapt future predictions based on real societal response.
Direct toggle endpoint that activates or deactivates a policy on a world.

get.description: Returns the six permanent council advisor identities in display order.

get.description: Returns structured standing briefing for the specified advisor based on live simulation state.

post.description:
Creates a new formal council deliberation session for a civilisation world.
Validates world access and participating advisors.

get.description: Lists council sessions for a civilisation world, newest first.
Returns complete session details including attendees, recommendations, decisions, and events.

post.description:
Concludes an active council session and seals its decrees in the Imperial Archives.
Cannot conclude an already completed or cancelled session.

get.description: Lists policy and civil recommendations filtered by world, advisor, or status.

post.description:
Creates an official recommendation proposed by an advisor.
Suitable for direct creation and Phase 3 intelligence engine integration.

get.description: Returns complete details of a specific recommendation.

post.summary: Review a recommendation (Accept, Reject, or Under Review)
post.description:
Executes a formal review of a recommendation.
Enforces business rule: ACCEPTED DOES NOT MEAN IMPLEMENTED.

get.description: Returns review events associated with the recommendation.

post.description:
Records an authoritative council decree on a recommendation.
Locked: Concluded or cancelled sessions cannot accept new decisions.

get.summary: Retrieve all decisions for a council session
get.description: Returns all decrees and ratifications recorded during a council session.

post.description:
Executes full multi-domain intelligence analysis across all six advisors on authoritative simulation state.
Evaluates domain findings, identifies risks, checks cross-domain trade-offs, and persists new recommendations.

get.description: Returns the most recent unified Council deliberation report for the civilisation.

post.summary: Execute domain intelligence for a single advisor
post.description: Runs domain analytical logic for an individual advisor on the specified world state.

get.summary: Retrieve active findings for an advisor
get.description: Returns evidence-backed analytical findings for an advisor on the current world state.

get.summary: Retrieve proposed recommendations for an advisor
get.description: Returns prospective recommendations formulated by the advisor's intelligence engine.

post.summary: Convoke all six advisors in royal session
post.description:
Executes formal convocation of all six advisors for an active council session.
Runs analytical logic, generates findings, risks, and recommendations, and performs trade-off analysis.

get.summary: Progressive streaming of advisor formal counsel
get.description:
Streams the formal speech of an advisor progressively using chunked text.
Provides responsive UI delivery while isolating presentation from authoritative decisions.
Returns detected genuine disagreements and competing objectives between advisors.
Returns comprehensive council overview: assessment, live advisor states, pending recs, and active session.

post.summary: Authorize and execute an accepted recommendation into simulation
post.description:
Submits an accepted recommendation for authorized execution into the simulation engine.
Validates resource availability, executes policy/decree, snapshots baseline metrics, and records implementation.

get.description: Calculates observable post-implementation metric deltas comparing baseline to current simulation state.

get.summary: List all recommendation execution records for a world
get.description: Returns historical implementation execution records.

Returns the machine learning model registry, active versions, test set metrics,
and fallback availability status.

post.description:
Generates multi-year forward projections with [p10, p50, p90] uncertainty intervals
for population, economic treasury, and inequality dynamics.
Fast surrogate execution under 200 ms.

get.description:
Returns incident and accident risk evaluation for the active world.
Predicts probability of severe incident and expected casualties based on
infrastructure and city attributes.

post.description:
Admin-only endpoint: fits empirical simulation parameters (Gompertz mortality,
Hadwiger fertility, accident splits, Gini bounds) to raw data and writes params_v1.json.

Admin-only endpoint: runs sandboxed AI policy controller evaluation (never touching real world state).
Returns recommended policy modifications with predicted impacts and confidence intervals,
recording an immutable audit trail.

Evaluates citizen diurnal behavioral state using the trained Neural MLP Classifier
(activity_sequence.joblib, 17,500 citizen-hours training observations).

Evaluates commuter transportation mode using the trained LightGBM Mode Choice Model
(mode_choice.joblib, 2,800 commuting trips across diverse zone topologies).

get.description:
Returns the anthropological and historical evolution dataset parameters,
Gompertz biological aging hazards, Hadwiger fertility distributions, and societal driver weights.

Returns the per-tick causal dependency graph, contributing factors,
and link strengths for deaths, hospital pressure, and civil protests.

Returns high-resolution time-series of vital statistics:
births, deaths by cause (aging, starvation, dehydration, hospital overload, pollution),
hospital bed occupancy, unmet basic needs, and protest intensity.

post.description:
Executes a batch of state-mutating commands (build, bulldoze, zone, road, policy, budget).
Provides atomic affordability check, RBAC, idempotency, and action logging.
Undoes the last reversible user action in the world.

get.description: Returns authoritative snapshot of the city with all entities, networks, and metrics.
Returns chronological audit log of all user commands executed in the world.
